job.job_title: FullStack Developer - Japanese IT Product based MNC - Kolkata (WFO)
job.job_description:
Job Summary: We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience in designing and developing scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React.js for frontend development, Python for backend development, and SQL databases. The role involves developing responsive user interfaces, building robust REST APIs, optimizing database performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.js.
Develop reusable UI components and implement modern frontend architecture.
Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
Design and optimize relational databases using SQL.
Write efficient, reusable, and maintainable code following coding standards.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs.
Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers when required.
Contribute to system architecture and technical design discussions.
Ensure application security, scalability, and high availability.



Mandatory Requirements:

6+ years of software development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with React.js.
Strong proficiency in Python backend development.
Experience developing RESTful APIs.
Good knowledge of SQL databases.
Experience working with Git.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design principles.
Excellent analytical and communication skills.
